title: Wedding catering orders

memories.content: Runs a catering business in Vijayawada

topics.ask: New order: wedding on 2026-12-06, 600 guests, lunch, veg. Price ₹450 per plate. Make the order summary.
topics.answer: Order summary: wedding lunch on 6 December 2026, 600 guests, vegetarian, ₹450 per plate, total ₹2,70,000. Advance (30%): ₹81,000 to confirm the date. Balance ₹1,89,000 due on or before the event day. Next: confirm the menu with the family, share it with Suresh for the grocery list, and book serving staff.

topics.ask: Family wants 650 guests now and one more sweet. Sweet adds ₹25 per plate.
topics.answer: Updated: 650 guests at ₹475 per plate, total ₹3,08,750. Advance was ₹81,000; the new 30% advance is ₹92,625, so ask for ₹11,625 more. Balance after the full advance: ₹2,16,125. Tell Suresh about the extra 50 plates and the sweet.

topics.ask: Make the timeline for the event day.
topics.answer: 5:00 am Suresh's team starts cooking; 9:00 am vegetables and sweets ready; 10:30 am loading; 11:15 am setup at the venue; 12:30 pm lunch service starts; 3:30 pm wind-up and collection of the balance ₹2,16,125.

ask: Summarise the wedding order, money received and pending.
